# CRASAR-U-DROIDs labels (Mexico Beach)

Building damage and road condition labels for the two Mexico Beach drone (sUAS) scenes of
Hurricane Michael (flown Oct 13 and Oct 14, 2018), plus CRASAR's building labels drawn on the
NOAA Oct 11, 2018 image. Used only for evaluation by `benchmarks/crasar_validation.py`;
FirstLight never sees them when grading or measuring.

Source: CRASAR-U-DROIDs, Center for Robot-Assisted Search and Rescue,
https://huggingface.co/datasets/CRASAR/CRASAR-U-DROIDs (files under `test/annotations/`).
License: CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Files are unmodified, renamed only.
Papers: Manzini et al., "CRASAR-U-DROIDs" (arXiv:2407.17673); road labels described in arXiv:2512.12128.
